title: Application for a hardship review – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains what personal information Service NSW collects when you apply for a hardship review.

more_info.text: you can access and seek correction of your information
privacy enquiries or complaints can be made.
Read the Service NSW privacy statement for more information on how:
You can call Service NSW on 13 77 88.
Service NSW is located at 2–24 Rawson Place Sydney NSW 2000.

faqs.q: What information is collected during a hardship review?
faqs.a: Service NSW collects information from government services, community organizations (like charities or support services), health professionals, and accredited financial counsellors who assessed your situation.

faqs.q: How will my personal information be used?
faqs.a: The information is used to assess your eligibility for hardship consideration, investigate allegations of fraud, and may be shared with law enforcement agencies or other bodies if fraud or criminal activity is suspected.

faqs.q: Do I have to provide this information?
faqs.a: The notice addresses whether you are required by law to provide the information.
